title: Presents
statementMd:
You are given the prices of three presents. Also there are three sisters. It is known that the most valuable present is for the eldest sister. The second (by price) is for the second sister. And the less valuable present is for the youngest sister. If two (or three) presents have the same price, corresponding sisters may get the in a random way.

## Input

The only line contains three integer numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3} ≤ 100$) — the prices of the presents.

## Output

Print three numbers $*i*_{1}, *i*_{2}, *i*_{3}$ ($1 ≤ *i*_{1}, *i*_{2}, *i*_{3} ≤ 3$), all of them should be distinct. The first number stands for the seniority of the sister which will get the first present (1 stands for the eldest, 3 for the youngest). The second and third numbers mean the seniority of the sisters which get the second and the third present respectively.

If there are multiple answers, print any of them.

## Note

In the second sample another possible answer is "2 3 1".
statementZhMd:
你得到了三件礼物的价格。现在有三位姐妹。已知最贵的礼物送给大姐，价格第二高的送给二姐，而最便宜的送给小妹。如果有两件（或三件）礼物价格相同，那么对应的姐妹可以随机获得这些礼物。

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含三个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3} ≤ 100$）——三件礼物的价格。

## 输出格式

输出三个整数 $*i*_{1}, *i*_{2}, *i*_{3}$（$1 ≤ *i*_{1}, *i*_{2}, *i*_{3} ≤ 3$），这三个数必须互不相同。第一个数表示将获得第一件礼物的姐妹的年长次序（1 表示大姐，3 表示小妹）。第二个和第三个数分别表示将获得第二件和第三件礼物的姐妹的年长次序。

如果有多个答案，输出任意一个即可。

## 说明

在第二个样例中，另一个可能的答案是“2 3 1”。
